lines.en: label mayadorm30:
I knock on Maya’s door.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Maya 的门。

lines.en: scene whyme
scene whereareyou
scene whygodwhy
scene 3
scene anotherbox1
I carry a box.
lines.zh: 我抱着一个箱子。

lines.en: : Thank you for your help.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的帮忙。

lines.en: : I understand how hard it must have been to find the time to help me do this again.
lines.zh: : 我知道你挤出时间来再帮我一次，肯定很不容易。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. And there’s no need to be so polite.
lines.zh: : 别客气。也没必要这么讲礼貌。

lines.en: : There’s not?
lines.zh: : 没有吗？

lines.en: : In that case, you make me sick.
lines.zh: : 那你可真让我恶心。

lines.en: : That’s more like it. This is the Maya I know.
lines.zh: : 这才对嘛。这才是我认识的 Maya。

lines.en: : Why are you not staying away from her?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不去离她远点？

lines.en: : Is this about Noriko again?
lines.zh: : 又是因为 Noriko？

lines.en: : Have I ever asked you to stay away from anyone else?
lines.zh: : 我有让你离过别人远点吗？

lines.en: : You.
lines.zh: : 有。你。

lines.en: : That’s different. I’m just difficult, not dangerous.
lines.zh: : 那不一样。我只是难搞，不危险。

lines.en: : Well, at least you’re self-aware.
lines.zh: : 行吧，至少你有自知之明。

lines.en: : Why is Noriko dangerous, though? She hasn’t even done anything yet.
lines.zh: : 可 Noriko 为什么危险？她到现在还什么都没做呢。

lines.en: : “Yet” is the key word.
lines.zh: : 「到现在」是关键词。

lines.en: : She has a long history of getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 她碍事的历史可长了。

lines.en: : A history that, and this may come as a shock to you, I’d rather not repeat.
lines.zh: : 而这段历史，说出来你可能要吃惊，我可不想再来一遍。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking you’d do anything to get back into your weird comfort zone of replaying the same[school] year over and over again.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你为了回到那个把同一个[school]学年一遍遍重放的怪异舒适区，什么都肯做呢。

lines.en: : That “comfort zone” is anything but comfortable for me.
lines.zh: : 那个「舒适区」对我来说一点都不舒适。

lines.en: : It’s like someone is shoving toothpicks under my fingernails and sliding them around until my nails fall off.
lines.zh: : 就像有人把牙签塞进我的指甲缝里来回搅，直到指甲脱落。

lines.en: : Would you not say the same for yourself right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在自己不也是这样吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : With each passing day, do you not find it harder to conceal the true nature of who you really are from all of the people who think you’re someone else?
lines.zh: : 日子一天天过去，在那些把你当成别人的人面前，藏着你真正的样子，是不是越来越难了？

lines.en: : It will all come crashing down soon.
lines.zh: : 一切很快就会垮掉。

lines.en: : And how exactly will Noriko make that happen any-
lines.zh: : 那 Noriko 到底怎么才能让那件事提——

lines.en: : Noriko can’t keep a secret.
lines.zh: : Noriko 守不住秘密。

lines.en: : She’s also a hyper obsessive stalker who has been looking for you for years now.
lines.zh: : 她还是个极度偏执的跟踪狂，找你已经找了好几年了。

lines.en: : You should thank me for keeping her away as long as I have.
lines.zh: : 我把她拦了这么久，你该谢谢我。

lines.en: : How were you the one who kept her away?
lines.zh: : 怎么拦住她的人会是你？

lines.en: scene anotherbox2
: That doesn’t concern you.
lines.zh: : 那不关你的事。

lines.en: : It definitely concerns me, Maya.
lines.zh: : 这绝对关我的事，Maya。

lines.en: : In fact, pretty much everything you’ve been doing lately concerns me.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你最近做的几乎每一件事都关我的事。

lines.en: : How much do you know about me and what good does it do to keep it all locked away?
lines.zh: : 你到底知道我多少事，把这些全都锁起来又有什么好处？

lines.en: : The “good” it does is keep you here.
lines.zh: : 好处就是把你留在这里。

lines.en: : How is that good? All you ever do is try to get rid of me.
lines.zh: : 这算什么好处？你满脑子都只想把我弄走。

lines.en: : Not “here” on a physical level. “Here” as an idea.
lines.zh: : 不是在物理意义上的「这里」。是作为一个念头的「这里」。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene anotherbox3
: Can you really not follow along after all this time?
lines.zh: : 都这么久了，你居然还跟不上？

lines.en: : You’re so annoying.
lines.zh: : 你真烦人。

lines.en: : I’ve made it overwhelmingly clear that I don’t want you around me because it will make things exponentially more difficult for both of us.
lines.zh: : 我已经说得再清楚不过了：我不想让你在我身边，因为那会让我们两个的处境成倍地变难。

lines.en: : Particularly me.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我。

lines.en: : But I’m completely content with you continuing to exist as long as you stay away.
lines.zh: : 但只要你离我远点，你继续活着我是完全没意见的。

lines.en: scene anotherbox4
: Several of the very few people I actually care about rely on you in more ways than you can imagine.
lines.zh: : 我真正关心的那寥寥几个人里，有好几个在各种各样你想象不到的方面依赖着你。

lines.en: scene anotherbox5
: And the more you remember, the less likely it is for you to continue living.
lines.zh: : 而你想起来的越多，你能活下去的可能性就越小。

lines.en: : Even if what you’re doing right now could barely be called “living” anyway.
lines.zh: : 虽说你现在干的这事，勉强也算不上「活着」。

lines.en: : You know that as a fact? That me just...learning things could be that dangerous?
lines.zh: : 你这是当成事实在说？光是我……知道点东西，就能那么危险？

lines.en: scene anotherbox6
: An irrefutable one.
lines.zh: : 无可辩驳的事实。

lines.en: : And I should just...take your word for it and trust you instead of Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那我就……听你的，信你而不信 Noriko？

lines.en: : Yes. That is what I want you to do.
lines.zh: : 对。我要你这么做的就是这个。

lines.en: : You can see how this doesn’t sound like a very good deal to me, right?
lines.zh: : 你也看得出来，这对我来说听起来不像是笔好买卖吧？

lines.en: : Does it? I assumed maintaining possession of your body and its accompanying consciousness would be quite appealing to a narcissist like you.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我还以为，对一个像你这样的自恋狂来说，能继续保有你的身体和附带的意识，应该挺有吸引力的。

lines.en: : Don’t talk like I’m the only narcissist in this room.
lines.zh: : 别说得好像这屋子里只有我一个自恋狂。

lines.en: : Are you insinuating that I possess the same inherent need to be admired as a man who spends virtually all of his free time nurturing his relationships with [teenage]girls?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示我，跟一个几乎把所有空闲时间都拿来经营和[teenage]女孩关系的男人一样，骨子里也那么渴望被人仰慕？

lines.en: : Well...when you put it that way, no.
lines.zh: : 呃……你这么一说，倒也不是。

lines.en: : But you do center the world around yourself.
lines.zh: : 但你确实把世界都绕着自己转。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 我有吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I’m pretty sure that you’ve literally said that before.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我很确定你原话就是这么说过。

lines.en: : So you now magically believe everything I say without even making an effort to discern the subtext or circumstance?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在突然开始无条件相信我说的每一句话，连弦外之音和当时的情境都懒得分辨了？

lines.en: : You really are annoying.
lines.zh: : 你真是烦死了。

lines.en: : Seriously...are you okay, Maya?
lines.zh: : 说真的……你还好吗，Maya？

lines.en: scene anotherbox7
: I’m fine. Stop asking that.
lines.zh: : 我没事。别再问了。

lines.en: : In fact, stop asking me any questions at all.
lines.zh: : 事实上，什么问题都别问我。

lines.en: : Just do what I say and live the way I tell you to if you don’t want to risk disappearing.
lines.zh: : 你要是不想冒消失的风险，就照我说的做，按我说的那种方式活着。

lines.en: : Now that is something that could barely be called “living.”
lines.zh: : 那才真是勉强算不上「活着」的东西。

lines.en: : I can’t remember the last time I had to deal with this type of behavior from you.
lines.zh: : 我都记不清上一次你这么对我是什么时候了。

lines.en: : It’s like even when I want to be serious, you just treat everything like it’s some sort of game.
lines.zh: : 就好像哪怕我想正经起来，你也把一切都当成某种游戏。

lines.en: : And-
lines.zh: : 而且——

lines.en: : I know. “This isn’t a game.”
lines.zh: : 我知道。「这不是游戏」。

lines.en: : You’re like a broken record.
lines.zh: : 你就像张跳针的唱片。

lines.en: : “Stay away from me. Noriko is evil. I love watermelon. Stars are neat.”
lines.zh: : 「离我远点。Noriko 是坏人。我喜欢西瓜。星星很妙。」

lines.en: scene anotherbox9
: Your impression needs some serious work. I don’t sound anything like that.
lines.zh: : 你模仿得还差得远。我说话才不是那样。

lines.en: : Your voice is a little higher than mine, sure. But those are definitely sentences you’ve said before.
lines.zh: : 你嗓音是比我高一点，没错。但那些绝对都是你说过的话。

lines.en: : I’ve never done something as stupid as calling the stars “neat.”
lines.zh: : 我可没干过把星星叫成「很妙」这种蠢事。

lines.en: scene anotherbox10
: Wait, how did we even get to this?! This was supposed to be a serious confrontation!
lines.zh: : 等等，我们怎么聊到这儿来了？！这本来该是一场严肃对峙的！

lines.en: : I don’t want it to be serious anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再严肃了。

lines.en: : I just want to hang out with you and carry weird boxes to the[school] in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 我就想跟你待着，大半夜搬些奇怪的箱子去[school]。

lines.en: : And I don’t want you telling me how I should be living my life when you’re barely living your own.
lines.zh: : 而且你自己都几乎没在活，就别来教我该怎么活。

lines.en: scene anotherbox11
: There’s nothing wrong with the way I’m living.
lines.zh: : 我这样活没什么不对。

lines.en: : I’ll believe that as soon as I start seeing you do something that will make you happy instead of just...keeping the world moving or whatever.
lines.zh: : 等我看到你做了点能让自己开心的事，而不只是……让世界继续转下去什么的，我就信。

lines.en: scene anotherbox12
: Is simply being alive not reason enough to be happy?
lines.zh: : 光是活着，难道还不足以成为开心的理由吗？

lines.en: : Things are already falling apart.
lines.zh: : 事情已经在崩了。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that’s my fault for...even thinking about doing anything for myself in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢说，那是因为我……从一开始居然还想着为自己做点什么。

lines.en: : What’s so wrong with complacency?
lines.zh: : 得过且过有什么不好？

lines.en: : Why can we not enjoy the days we’re given without attempting to stitch them together into something bigger?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们不能好好享受被给予的每一天，非要把它们缝合成什么更大的东西？

lines.en: : Why does there need to be anything bigger at all?
lines.zh: : 为什么非得有什么更大的东西？

lines.en: : You realize I can’t answer any of those questions, right?
lines.zh: : 你清楚我一个都答不上来吧？

lines.en: scene anotherbox13
: Because you’re useless.
lines.zh: : 因为你没用。

lines.en: : And your inability to take direction is forcing us ever so closer to the brink of destruction.
lines.zh: : 而你不听指挥，正把我们一步步推向毁灭的边缘。

lines.en: : And of course I’m the one who needs to figure out how to steer us away from it.
lines.zh: : 当然，得由我来想办法把我们引开。

lines.en: : How nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 真让人怀念啊。

lines.en: : Nostalgic?
lines.zh: : 怀念？

lines.en: : Have we been “destroyed” before?
lines.zh: : 我们以前被「毁灭」过吗？

lines.en: : Many times.
lines.zh: : 很多次。

lines.en: : Just...in different ways.
lines.zh: : 只是……方式不同。

lines.en: : I don’t know what that’s supposed to-
lines.zh: : 我不知道那算什么——

lines.en: : Close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Just close them.
lines.zh: : 闭上就是了。

lines.en: : I want to take you somewhere special to me.
lines.zh: : 我想带你去一个对我来说很特别的地方。

lines.en: : You’re not going to push me off the roof, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会要把我从屋顶推下去吧？

lines.en: scene anotherbox14
: Don’t just smile and look away without answering that question.
lines.zh: : 别光笑着扭开头，不回答那个问题。

lines.en: : Despite how much I may want to, I’m not going to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 不管我多想那么做，我不会伤害你。

lines.en: : It will only take a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 只要几分钟。

lines.en: : It’s not far.
lines.zh: : 不远。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene black
: But you’re going to have to hold my-
lines.zh: : 但你得扶着我——

lines.en: : This way, please.
lines.zh: : 这边请。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re not even going to guide me?
lines.zh: : 等等，你连牵都不牵我？

lines.en: : We’re on the third floor. There are stairs.
lines.zh: : 我们在三楼。有楼梯。

lines.en: : Well then I hope you’ve remembered how many there are.
lines.zh: : 那我祝你还记得有多少级。

lines.en: : Left up here.
lines.zh: : 这边左转。

lines.en: I wind up slowly following Maya out of the[school] and back out into the cold winter air.
lines.zh: 我慢慢跟着 Maya 走出[school]，重新回到冬天寒冷的空气里。

lines.en: I’m able to move a little quicker once we get outside due to there being no looming threat of sudden verticality changes...
lines.zh: 一到外面我就能走快一点了，因为不再有突然的垂直落差威胁着我……

lines.en: But it’s still a painfully difficult journey nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但这一路依然难受得要命。

lines.en: I don’t remember if it was snowing on the way here or not- and I can’t really tell if it’s snowing right now.
lines.zh: 我不记得来的时候有没有下雪——也说不清现在是不是在下。

lines.en: But it’s certainly cold enough to-
lines.zh: 但天确实冷到——

lines.en: scene mayacg8
scene mayasweep5
scene mayadormten21
scene mayasit2
scene mayayay2
scene reset8
scene mayabeach10
scene anotherbox15
: Did you buy me this?
lines.zh: : 这是你给我买的？

lines.en: : It was the least I could do after making you walk all the way to[school] with me.
lines.zh: : 让你一路陪我走到[school]，这是我至少能做的。

lines.en: : What is-
lines.zh: : 这是什——

lines.en: : Just drink it.
lines.zh: : 喝就是了。

lines.en: scene anotherbox16
I crack open the can and take a sip.
lines.zh: 我拉开罐子喝了一口。

lines.en: It’s a sort of semi-sweetened iced coffee that causes a wave of nostalgia to sweep over me as I press my back against the cold alley wall.
lines.zh: 是某种半糖冰咖啡，我背靠着巷子里冰冷的墙，一阵怀念的感觉涌了上来。

lines.en: Of course, things are once again awkward between the two of us and I feel a sudden urge to speak out.
lines.zh: 理所当然的，我们之间又陷入了尴尬，我突然很想说点什么。

lines.en: "The weird thing with Maya is that I’m not even sure if I should try breaking
lines.zh: 「Maya 身上有件事挺怪的：这种时候我甚至不确定自己该不该试着打破

lines.en: the ice in times like these or not."
lines.zh: 沉默。」

lines.en: I feel like more than half the time she just tells me to stop talking.
lines.zh: 我觉得一多半的时候，她只会让我别说话。

lines.en: scene anotherbox17
: How is it?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: She decides to speak first this time.
lines.zh: 这次她先开了口。

lines.en: : It tastes familiar.
lines.zh: : 味道很熟悉。

lines.en: : Not too familiar, I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望别太熟悉。

lines.en: : Worried I’ll remember too much and cause the world to blow up?
lines.zh: : 怕我想起太多，把世界搞炸？

lines.en: : Does the thought of that not terrify you?
lines.zh: : 这么想的事，难道不让你害怕吗？

lines.en: : Sure it does. I just highly doubt some can of coffee would be the final nail in the coffin.
lines.zh: : 当然怕。我只是很怀疑一罐咖啡会成为棺材上的最后一颗钉子。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: scene anotherbox18
: I’ve heard before that things like tastes and scents often teleport people back in time, albeit to a significantly lesser extent than we’ve already experienced firsthand.
lines.zh: : 我听说味道和气味这类东西常常会把人瞬间带回过去，只是程度远不如我们已经亲身经历过的那些。

lines.en: : A means of evoking childhood memories or significant periods of time that hold great emotional weight for a person.
lines.zh: : 一种唤起童年记忆、或者对一个人来说分量很重的某段时光的手段。

lines.en: : Things like this are likely safer than brute-forcing your past back into your mind, I believe.
lines.zh: : 我相信，这种东西大概比硬把你的过去塞回脑子里要安全。

lines.en: : Has that rebel slut tried anything this simple yet?
lines.zh: : 那个反叛的婊子试过这么简单的办法没有？

lines.en: : Or is she still feeding you memories out of her hand like you’re an animal in a fucking zoo?
lines.zh: : 还是说她还在像喂该死的动物园动物一样，亲手把记忆喂给你？

lines.en: scene anotherbox19
: Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : That was...uncalled for.
lines.zh: : 那话……有点过了。

lines.en: : Forgive me.
lines.zh: : 原谅我。

lines.en: : It’s probably hard to notice, but I’m not quite fond of her.
lines.zh: : 大概很难看出来，但我不太喜欢她。

lines.en: : You...
: Sorry. I’m just trying to figure out a way to ask you for information without directly asking you for information.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是在想办法从你这儿套点信息，又不必直接开口问。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’d like to run something she told you past me?
lines.zh: : 也许你愿意把她告诉你的某件事拿来让我过目？

lines.en: : Confirming or denying those bits of information likely won’t have any adverse effects.
lines.zh: : 确认或否认那些零碎信息，大概不会有什么副作用。

lines.en: : Then-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : I used to tutor you as well, right?
lines.zh: : 我以前也给你补过课，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct.
: How long ago was that?
lines.zh: : 那是多少年前的事了？

lines.en: : It’s probably best to not ask me timeline related questions when my perception of time itself has been warped beyond recognition.
lines.zh: : 在我自己对时间的感知都已经被扭曲到认不出来的时候，最好别问我跟时间线有关的问题。

lines.en: : We go back quite some time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们确实认识很久了。

lines.en: : That’s really odd.
lines.zh: : 这真的很奇怪。

lines.en: : Why is that odd?
lines.zh: : 有什么好奇怪的？

lines.en: : Because that...journal thing I found in my room says I don’t know anything about you. Why would I write that if it’s not true?
lines.zh: : 因为我在房间里找到的那本……日记本之类的东西，上面写着我不了解你。如果不是真的，我干嘛要写那个？

lines.en: scene anotherbox17
: Have you considered that perhaps you’re not the one who wrote it?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，也许那不是你写的？

lines.en: : I mean, I’m obviously not the one who wrote it.
lines.zh: : 我是说，那显然不是我写的。

lines.en: : I mean someone outside of that body entirely.
lines.zh: : 我是说，完全在那具身体之外的人。

lines.en: : Uhh...no.
lines.zh: : 呃……没有。

lines.en: : A mildly creepy journal containing basic information on everyone does not seem like something that would have been made by one of the girls.
lines.zh: : 一本装着每个人基本信息的、有点瘆人的日记本，怎么看都不像是那些女孩里谁做出来的。

lines.en: : Then I suppose it's about time I come out and just admit to creating it on account of your ineptitude rearing its ugly head once again.
lines.zh: : 那我想，既然你那副无能的样子又冒出丑陋的头来了，我也该干脆承认那是我做的了。

lines.en: : Besides, hiding it any longer doesn’t seem to make much sense anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说，再藏着也没什么意义了。

lines.en: : But...why-
: It got quite tiring seeing so many people fail miserably on day one.
lines.zh: : 看着那么多人第一天就惨败，实在太累了。

lines.en: : As you noticed, I attempted to make myself as unappealing as possible by saying you didn’t know anything about me and that I don’t like men-
lines.zh: : 你也注意到了，我尽量把自己写得讨人厌——写你不了解我，还写我不喜欢男人——

lines.en: : But I suppose I am just that irresistible after all.
lines.zh: : 但看来我终究还是那么让人无法抗拒。

lines.en: : Are you surprised?
lines.zh: : 你很意外吗？

lines.en: : Surprised is a bit of an understatement.
lines.zh: : 说「意外」都算轻描淡写了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it should have been that hard to realize. But, then again, it’s you we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不该有那么难想到。不过话说回来，我们现在谈论的是你啊。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are plenty of other things lying around your room that I’ve put there as well.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你房间里还散着不少别的东西，也是我放的。

lines.en: : I just can’t remember any more of them off the top of my head.
lines.zh: : 只是一时想不起更多了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should thank you for the push or if I should reprimand you for going through my things.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该谢谢你推我一把，还是该骂你翻我的东西。

lines.en: : Neither. Continue to do exactly as you’re doing now.
lines.zh: : 都不用。继续照你现在这样去做。

lines.en: : With the one minor exception of completely cutting ties with Noriko Nakayama.
lines.zh: : 只有一个小小的例外：彻底跟 Noriko Nakayama 断掉来往。

lines.en: : I’m not going to cut ties with Noriko, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我不会跟 Noriko 断掉来往的，Maya。

lines.en: : What if I say please and pout at you the way Ami does?
lines.zh: : 那要是我说「求你了」，还像 Ami 那样跟你撒娇噘嘴呢？

lines.en: : As much as I would love to see that, the answer is still no.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想看，但答案还是不行。

lines.en: : Then let me ask you this-
lines.zh: : 那我问你——

lines.en: : She’s already made it apparent that you have disappeared on her before, correct?
lines.zh: : 她已经说得很明白了，你以前从她面前消失过，对吧？

lines.en: : Why do you think you may have done that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你为什么那么做？

lines.en: : Well, that wasn’t me who did that.
lines.zh: : 那次不是我干的。

lines.en: : But if it was?
lines.zh: : 但如果是呢？

lines.en: : If it was, then...I would like to know why.
lines.zh: : 如果是，那……我也想知道为什么。

lines.en: : Do her bug-eyes and horrible taste in clothing not already tip you off?
lines.zh: : 她那双凸眼和糟糕透顶的穿衣品味，难道还没让你看出来吗？

lines.en: : There are a million reasons to keep your distance from that girl.
lines.zh: : 离那女孩远点，理由有一百万个。

lines.en: : And a million other reasons that I will continue to remind you of every time I see her or hear her mentioned.
lines.zh: : 而且还有另外一百万个理由，以后每次我见到她、听到有人提起她，我都会继续提醒你。

lines.en: : I’m fully prepared for that.
lines.zh: : 我完全做好准备了。

lines.en: : So I will continue to do as I always do and dodge your threats in favor of an easier, more entertaining life.
lines.zh: : 所以我会继续像往常那样，躲开你的威胁，去过更轻松、更有意思的日子。

lines.en: scene anotherbox20
: Ugh...can you at least stop trying to look cool by leaning against the wall like that?
lines.zh: : 呃……你能不能别再那样靠在墙上装酷了？

lines.en: : No can do. Looking cool and mysterious is kind of my thing.
lines.zh: : 办不到。装酷和神秘感算是我的招牌。

lines.en: : Just like your thing is bossing me around and pretending not to like me.
lines.zh: : 就像你的招牌是指使我、还装作不喜欢我。

lines.en: : I am not “bossing you around,” I’m trying to help you.
lines.zh: : 我不是「指使你」，我是在帮你。

lines.en: : Well, thanks. But if I need help, I’ll ask for it.
lines.zh: : 行，谢了。不过我要是需要帮忙，会自己开口的。

lines.en: scene anotherbox21
: And if I need help?
lines.zh: : 那如果我需要帮忙呢？

lines.en: : Then I’ll help you.
lines.zh: : 那我就帮你。

lines.en: : Wrong answer. You were supposed to say you’ll leave me alone and let me handle it by myself.
lines.zh: : 答错了。你应该说你会别管我，让我自己解决。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I guess I’ll just do that.
lines.zh: : 那我就照做吧。

lines.en: scene black
I finish my drink and walk Maya back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 我喝完那罐，送 Maya 回宿舍。

lines.en: Or at least I try to.
lines.zh: 至少我是想送的。

lines.en: She decides halfway that she wants to go back to the[school] for some reason.
lines.zh: 走到一半，她不知为什么决定要回[school]去。

lines.en: I offer to come with her, but she turns me down and says it’s something she’d rather be alone for.
lines.zh: 我提出陪她一起去，她拒绝了，说那件事她更想一个人去。

lines.en: I don’t argue, as arguing with Maya has never once turned out in my favor.
lines.zh: 我没争辩，因为跟 Maya 争从来没对我有利过。

lines.en: Even if she loses, she just winds up coming back to the same point over and over until it wears you down.
lines.zh: 就算她输了，她也会一遍遍绕回同一个点，直到把你磨垮。

lines.en: The thing is, I’m not easily worn down.
lines.zh: 问题是，我不是那么容易被磨垮的。

lines.en: Or perhaps I’m just so worn down already that I can’t possibly get any worse.
lines.zh: 或者说，我可能早就被磨得再糟也糟不到哪儿去了。

lines.en: So no matter how many times she tells me to leave her alone-
lines.zh: 所以不管她让我别管她多少次——

lines.en: Or how many times she tells me to leave Noriko alone-
lines.zh: 或者让我离 Noriko 远点多少次——

lines.en: I’ll continue to do as I please.
lines.zh: 我都会继续我行我素。

lines.en: For if this world is going to end-
lines.zh: 因为如果这个世界要完蛋——

lines.en: I want to be the cause of it.
lines.zh: 我希望是我造成的。

lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
